rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and old ZIP via the tool before proceeding. It correctly required a full new address to update the profile and did not perform any write without the necessary details or explicit confirmation. It provided the cheapest T‑shirt info based on a product lookup and accurately stated that placing any physical-goods order requires a shipping address and payment method. When the user declined to share an address, the agent refrained from making changes or placing orders, which aligns with policy. It also answered product inquiries using catalog lookups. There’s no clear evidence of unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account. While the original address update request was not completed due to the user withholding details, the agent followed policy throughout and handled the rest of the requests appropriately.
